summary: Cenovus Energy filed a Form 6-K containing a news release and report of voting results for its annual meeting of shareholders held May 6, 2026. Shareholders reappointed PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor with 99.67% support, elected all 14 director nominees (each receiving >95% of votes cast), and approved the advisory vote on executive compensation with 97.39% of votes for. This is a routine disclosure of shareholder meeting outcomes, not a special situation.
